#  11166 - Bachelor Thesis - Design Project in Cooperation with Urban Design Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11166 - module is no longer offered from WS 2016/17**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Bachelor Thesis - Design Project in Cooperation with Urban Design**  |  
|  Bachelor Arbeit - Entwurfsprojekt in Kooperation mit Städtebau   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Huckriede, Bernd 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  10   |  
| Learning Outcome:  |  The content of this course takes the form of a project that deals with examples of building in urban context and existing structures, with developing complex forms of housing in hybrid situations. It aims at conveying competence in planning social and public buildings, using methodical, experimental and investigating know-how equivalent to the professional activities of architects according to the level of third year studies.  |  
| Contents:  |  This module aims at combining theoretical thinking with specialized architectural skills, integrating knowledge of different fields like urban planning, economics and law, history and theory, technology and arts in one design project. Organization and content of module: 50% scientific basics, 20% methodic, 30% specialized knowledge.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Design project / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 210 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Specific compilations of relevant literature will be available during the semester in the university library.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Graduate Thesis/External Practical Trainings/Excursion  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  |  Design Project. Basic teaching methods are tutored sessions in the studio and public presentations in front of the group. Students develop the design for a project according to the basic topics of the architectural discipline in social, scientific, methodical and artistic aspects. Creative thinking and the ability to work in a team are primary methods of design. Responsible design (architectural, functional and social) is an important part of the learning process, with aesthetic and technical consequences. Designing means collecting information, defining problems and finding solutions through critical analysis. Designing means also to be able to think in three dimensions and to develop methodical strategies to build these spaces according to demands of user, structure and materiality. Models and CAD drawings are indispensable tools of this process. Other important topics of this design course are the relationship between person and space, spaces and buildings, buildings and landscape; historical context; artistic expression; economical criteria and, one of the main competences of the architect, the ability to coordinate: Every participant of the building process has to be convinced, managed and enthused.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  |  Working in the studio is obligatory. Offer for Study Programme: Double Degree Bachelor Architektur in cooperation with Wadi International University, Syria  |  
| Module Components:  | -  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
